scopes.description: Primary discovery membership. Include a residual or integration scope for shared code and loose root files that need discovery coverage.

sharedScope.description: Optional shared context only. With sharedDiscovery=false its files are not covered for discovery unless included in a primary scope.

id.description: Unique portable identifier using ASCII letters, digits, hyphen or underscore. Dependencies reference this exact id.

sharedDependencies.description: Exact ids of other scopes declared in scopes or sharedScope. Never undeclared package names, file paths or this scope's own id. Use [] when there is no declared dependency.
